# optimizelycmssaas_content_type (Data Source)

Looks up an existing content_type by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmssaas_content_type" "image" {
  key = "ImageMedia"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the content_type to look up.

### Read-Only

- `access_rights` (Attributes List) Who may create content of this type. Empty means everyone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_rights))
- `allow_data_loss` (Boolean) Let updates go through even when the CMS considers them breaking, e.g. removing a property that content may use. That deletes the stored values. Off by default: the apply then fails with the CMS's message.
- `base_type` (String) Base type, e.g. _page, _component, _media, _experience. Required unless is_contract. Cannot be changed.
- `composition_behaviors` (List of String) e.g. sectionEnabled, elementEnabled.
- `contracts` (List of String) Contract types this type is bound to.
- `description` (String) Description of the content type (at most 255 characters).
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the CMS.
- `is_contract` (Boolean) Whether this is a contract type. Cannot be changed.
- `may_contain_types` (List of String) Content types that can be created in containers of this type.
- `media_file_extensions` (List of String) Media file extensions this type handles.
- `properties_json` (String) JSON object of property definitions keyed by property name (use jsonencode). Drift is detected structurally; fields the API adds as defaults are ignored.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position when sorting content types. Assigned by the CMS when unset.

<a id="nestedatt--access_rights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_rights`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the user, role or application.
- `type` (String) user, role or application. Defaults to role.
